q: Can I use a SIDBI machinery loan to replace old, energy-hungry machines?
title: SIDBI machinery loan for new machines
short: Yes. SIDBI's machinery loans fund equipment for new units, expansion and modernisation through three schemes: EXPRESS up to ₹3 crore and UDAY up to ₹50 lakh, both repaid over up to 60 months, and SPEED up to ₹15 crore over up to 84 months. How long you have been running decides which one you can use.
audience: MSME owners replacing old motors, compressors, furnaces or production machines

ul: EXPRESS: for units running at least three years, with Udyam and GST registration. Up to ₹3 crore, up to 100 percent of cost with 25 percent security as a fixed deposit, repaid over up to 60 months. Assessed digitally, with an in-principle offer straight away.

SPEED: for units running at least three years with cash profit in the last three financial years. Up to ₹15 crore: 100 percent with 25 percent kept as a fixed deposit, or up to 75 percent of project cost with your own contribution. Repaid over up to 84 months, including up to 12 months moratorium.

UDAY: for new units and units under three years old. Up to ₹50 lakh, up to 100 percent with 25 to 30 percent security as a fixed deposit, repaid over up to 60 months including up to 9 months moratorium.
All three need a clean record: no defaults to any bank or financial institution.

p: SPEED now allows second-hand or refurbished machines, subject to SIDBI's standard guidelines. EXPRESS and UDAY are described for new machinery. If you are buying a used press or furnace, ask before you pay a deposit to the seller.

SPEED and SIDBI's 4E energy efficiency loan have the same structure: up to ₹15 crore, 100 percent against a 25 percent deposit or 75 percent with your own share, up to 84 months. The difference is what you must prove. SPEED does not ask whether the machine saves energy. 4E requires you to establish an energy efficiency gain or an emissions cut, and in return the loan counts as green finance, which helps if a buyer or a later lender asks how your projects were funded. If the replacement is mainly about saving power or fuel and you can show it from your bills, 4E is worth the extra paperwork.
Apply online through the Apply Now option on SIDBI's website, which opens its loan portal, or ask your nearest SIDBI branch or a referral partner registered with SIDBI to help with the form.

example.title: Two units, two different schemes
lines: Unit A, running 2 years, replacing an old compressor for ₹40 lakh: only UDAY fits (under three years, up to ₹50 lakh); fixed deposit at 25 to 30 percent = ₹10 lakh to ₹12 lakh
Unit B, running 6 years, replacing three induction furnaces for ₹4 crore: above the EXPRESS cap of ₹3 crore, so SPEED or 4E
Unit B's expected saving: 150 kWh per tonne x 6,000 tonnes a year = 9,00,000 kWh (assumed figures; use your supplier's guarantee)
CO2 avoided: 9,00,000 kWh x 0.675 kg per kWh (CEA grid factor, FY 2025-26) = 6,07,500 kg, about 607 tonnes a year
example.note: With a saving that size, Unit B can apply under 4E on the same money terms as SPEED and show the project as green, provided its bills and melt records back up the before and after.

senseible: Senseible compares energy per unit of output before and after a machine change from your bills and production records, the evidence 4E asks for and a quick way to check the new machine delivered the saving you paid for.
